subject: Air-gapped SIG: offline evidence routing and support model
messages:
From: GlobalBank Compliance <sig-requests@globalbank.com>

Subject: SIG addendum for air-gapped deployment - evidence & delivery questions

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our compliance team did a quick pass on the SIG baseline and asked for an air-gapped addendum that covers:

- How you will deliver offline patches and model artifacts (physical media or hand-delivered encrypted archive).
- Evidence of patch verification and file hashes (who performs verification and where logs are retained).
- The procedure for emergency security patches (timeline and on-call support).
- Proof of custody and chain-of-custody documentation for shipped media.

Can Redwood provide a short addendum and an example checklist we can include with our procurement packet? We have an internal procurement window the week of Dec 14, so a draft by Nov 30 would be ideal.

Thanks,
Ava Collins
Senior Compliance Manager, GlobalBank
sig-requests@globalbank.com

Subject: Re: SIG addendum for air-gapped deployment - evidence & delivery questions

Hi Ava — thanks for the clear list. We can do this.

High-level proposal:
- Provide a SIG addendum that enumerates offline update methods (USB hand-off with HSM-wrapped artifacts, encrypted HDD shipment with tracked courier, and signed S3 export under customer-controlled KMS for private/offsite transfer).
- Include a verification appendix: sample SHA256 manifests, verification steps, and retention policy (we keep verification logs in the customer's private audit bucket for 90 days by default; longer by request).
- Support model: standard Redwood Private SLA applies; for physical deliveries we add an "on-site coordination" addendum with a dedicated escalation engineer and a 24/7 hotline for the delivery window. Emergency patch SLA: 24 hours for critical security patches, with a documented escalation path.

I'll attach a draft addendum and a shipping checklist for your review. Can you confirm whether GlobalBank requires Red Team attestation or independent verification for shipped media?

Thanks — I can get a draft to you by EOD Nov 30.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Trust & Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai

Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG addendum for air-gapped deployment - internal tech notes

Looping in some technical notes for the addendum draft. Key points to confirm before finalizing:

- Artifact generation: we will emit SHA256 manifests and GPG-sign the manifest with our release key. For customers who require KMS-wrapped exports, we can coordinate an export process to the customer's S3 bucket where Redwood writes the object encrypted with the customer's key.
- Verification logs: the agent that performs the install will POST a signed installation receipt (JSON) to a temporary audit queue. For air-gapped installs the install receipt is bundled with the media (signed and timestamped) and also mirrored to the customer's audit bucket when connectivity is restored.
- Emergency patching: engineering can provide a signed patch bundle and remote-runbook; for the truly air-gapped site we ship the patch on encrypted media and provide a phone/Zoom session for guided install.

Open questions for Olga/Evelyn: what level of indemnity wording does legal want in the chain-of-custody section, and should we offer a customer-supplied courier (preferred) vs Redwood-managed courier as two separate line items?

- Hiro
Senior Infrastructure Engineer

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@globalbank.com>
Cc: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:57:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG addendum for air-gapped deployment - evidence & delivery questions

Ava — attached is the draft addendum and a shipping checklist per your ask. Highlights and decisions we propose:

1) Delivery options: (a) Customer-supplied courier (recommended) — Redwood packages and transfers custody to courier; (b) Redwood-managed secure courier — Redwood uses SecureShip (pre-vetted) and provides a chain-of-custody form and two-person sign-off at pickup/delivery.

2) Verification: We provide SHA256 manifests, GPG-signed manifests, and an install receipt template. For customers that require independent attestation we can arrange a third-party verification partner at cost.

3) Support & escalation: For air-gapped deliveries we add a 72-hour coordination SLA (scheduling, test install window), and for P1 security patches we guarantee 24-hour delivery of a signed patch bundle plus a named escalation engineer during the delivery window.

4) Evidence retention: Install receipts bundled with the shipment are archived to the customer's private audit bucket within 72 hours of restored network connectivity. Default retention is 90 days; extended retention is available as an add-on.

Please review the attached and let me know any redlines. If acceptable, I'll generate a DocuSign for the addendum and a shipping runbook.

Olga

Attachments: SIG_addendum_draft_v1.pdf, airgap-shipping-checklist.xlsx, evidence-agent-instructions.txt

From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@globalbank.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Air-gapped SIG: offline evidence routing and support model

Thanks, Olga — this looks good and addresses the majority of our asks. A few clarifications before procurement sign-off:

- Chain-of-custody: we prefer customer-supplied courier when possible. If Redwood uses SecureShip, please include SecureShip's insurance summary and pickup/delivery time windows.
- Proof of verification: can Redwood confirm the retention location for install receipts (we need the exact S3 bucket pattern and who has read access)?
- DocuSign: please send the DocuSign link for the addendum and a separate exhibit for the paid coordination hours.

We will also need SecureShip to provide a rate card for insured shipments to our EU and US sites (cc'd courier). Once we have those items, procurement will slot this for the Dec 14 review.

Ava Collins
Senior Compliance Manager, GlobalBank
